description: React component for LDAP text setting in Mattermost admin console LDAP wizard, including validation, tooltip, and LDAP test result display.

methods.name: sanitizeValue
methods.description: Converts input value to string, handling null, undefined, and NaN.

methods.name: isFilterTest
methods.description: Checks if LDAP test result is a filter test based on test_name.

methods.name: isGroupAttributeTest
methods.description: Checks if LDAP test result is a group attribute test based on test_name.

methods.name: getIconClass
methods.description: Returns icon class based on LDAP test result status.

methods.name: getIconCssClass
methods.description: Returns CSS class for icon color based on LDAP test result status.

methods.name: getTooltipContent
methods.description: Generates tooltip message content based on LDAP test result and current value.
